abilities.name: Ogre Hide
abilities.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor, but reduce Gall's damage by 25%.; 5; trait

fields.notes: Shares cooldown with Gall's Ogre Rage. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Surging Fist
abilities.description: Activate to begin charging Surging Fist. Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46 damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash
fields.props: Clamping, Knockback, Mobile channel, Piercing Skillshot
fields.notes: Surging Fist can be channeled for up to 5 seconds, but its range ceases to grow after 2 seconds. Cho cannot attack while channeling Surging Fist. While dashing, Cho'gall's unit radius is reduced to 0.75. While channeling this Ability, Cho can target an ally Mounted with the Toy Train equipped to Mount.

abilities.name: Consuming Blaze
abilities.description: Ignite nearby enemies, dealing 150 damage over 5 seconds. Basic Attacking burning enemies re-Ignites them. Cho is healed for 40 when an enemy is Ignited.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Modifier, Damage over Time

abilities.name: Rune Bomb
abilities.description: Roll a bomb dealing 91 damage to enemies in its path. Gall can use Runic Blast to detonate it to deal 221 damage in an area.

abilities.name: Hammer of Twilight
abilities.description: Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds. Passive Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.; 15; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: 1) Search is performed in three 73.3 degree sections rotating counter-clockwise over three successive ticks. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Cho's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.description: After 1 second, pull enemies toward Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 damage.; 40; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Pull, Slow

talents.name: Consuming Fire
talents.description: Consuming Blaze heals for 150% more when a Hero is Ignited.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other effects that can increase healing dealt by Consuming Blaze and multiplicatively with effects that affect healing received.

_raw_fields: Consuming Blaze heals for 150% more when a Hero is Ignited.

talents.name: Calloused Hide
talents.description: While under 60% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other effects that affect healing received and multiplicatively with other healing modifiers.

_raw_fields: While under 60% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

talents.name: The Will Of Cho
talents.description: questonly Killing enemy Minions grants 1 stack of The Will of Cho, and Hero takedowns grant 10 stacks. Gain 1 Armor for every 30 stacks, up to a maximum of 10 Armor. This Armor bonus stacks with Ogre Hide.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself and Ogre Hide, but not with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: questonly Killing enemy Minions grants 1 stack of The Will of Cho, and Hero takedowns grant 10 stacks. Gain 1 Armor for every 30 stacks, up to a maximum of 10 Armor. This Armor bonus stacks with Ogre Hide.

talents.name: Uppercut
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage is dealt in an additional instance. Each Hero hit grants cooldown reduction.

_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

talents.name: Rollback
talents.description: Rune Bomb rolls back to Cho, damaging enemies in its path.

fields.notes: Rune Bomb continues to the maximum range before returning. Rune Bomb deals collision damage in both ways. Gall can still activate Rune Bomb only once per cast.

_raw_fields: Rune Bomb rolls back to Cho, damaging enemies in its path.

talents.name: Seared Flesh
talents.description: Each consecutive Basic Attack to an enemy Hero deals 20% more damage, to a maximum of 60% damage. This bonus lasts 5 seconds or until a non-Heroic enemy is attacked.

fields.notes: Damage bonus is applied before damage is dealt, starting from 0%. Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Cho's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Each consecutive Basic Attack to an enemy Hero deals 20% more damage, to a maximum of 60% damage. This bonus lasts 5 seconds or until a non-Heroic enemy is attacked.

talents.name: Power Surge
talents.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.
_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks against ignited Heroes decrease the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 1 second. Passive Reduce the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 3 seconds.
